label: Diagram 2.38
caption: Diagram 2.38 Wall type 4 – external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf
description: The image contains two columns of plan views. The right-hand column is headed "Diagram 2.38 Wall type 4 – external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf" in a green box and is marked PLAN in its lower right corner. It shows a wall running vertically, made of two parallel leaves with a cross-hatched cavity between them, the inner leaf being shown with diagonal hatching, met by a perpendicular wall extending to the right that has a cross-hatched upper layer and a plain lower layer. At the junction, small squares each marked with a diagonal cross are shown, and two leader lines from the label "Cavity stops" point to these squares. The left-hand column is cut off at the top, where a plan detail (its letter label not visible) shows a wall with squares marked with a diagonal cross and, at the very top, an arrow labelled "detail" pointing to a small triangular symbol. Below this, two further plan details labelled (b) and (c) are shown, with a single PLAN label at the bottom of the column. Each depicts two parallel cross-hatched walls with a plain gap between them and squares marked with a diagonal cross on the inner faces. In (c) an additional square marked with a diagonal cross is set within a hatched block on the left-hand wall, pointed to by an arrow labelled "Socket detail".
